mintAuthority.summary: At Ethereum block 26098754, three modules can mint USDU: the curator-operated Morpho USDU adapter and two permissionless SwapBridgeMorphoV1 modules accepting USDC or USDT into ERC-4626 vaults. The token itself remains module-gated; users can invoke the approved swap modules. Historical expired modules retain burn rights, and the uncapped Morpho/curator issuance path remains adverse.

controls.label: Whitelisted USDU adapters (Curve / TermMax / Morpho)
controls.evidence: Round-2 enumeration of all 19 indexed SetModule events returned 11 distinct historical modules with no next page. At Ethereum block 26098754, checkValidModule returned true only for 0xfb46481a9819e068af0eb64a2c2824fcecaaaa45 and the newly reviewed USDC/USDT swap modules 0x6b6893d82edbc8d6769ba3c407102d33da2b623f and 0xd9141f634ef9e871a5fe4f64195747db77a13f3e; the other eight candidates returned false. MorphoAdapterV1_2.deposit(amount) is onlyCurator, mints USDU and deposits that USDU into its own-denominated Morpho vault without a fixed mint cap. The historical failure-domain keys are retained because expiration removes mint validity but does not remove burnModule rights.

controls.label: USDU DAO / curator (adapter whitelist authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26098754, curator() returned 0x9fe66037c44236c87d9ac8345f489b4413fdff06, guardian() was zero and timelock() was 604800 seconds. The curator still governs module approval. Indexed SetModule events include permissionless finalizers other than the curator, so the earlier sole-submitter description does not describe the complete current event history.

controls.label: USDU USDC SwapBridgeMorphoV1 module
controls.capDescription: Immutable 100000-USDU mintCap bounds principal swap issuance; fee and surplus-reconciliation minting are not a hard total-liability cap. Permissionless swapIn accepts USDC and deposits into ERC-4626 vault 0xbeef088055857739c12cd3765f20b7679def0f51; swapOut burns USDU and withdraws USDC. Both fees are 1000 ppm.

sources.label: Verified USDC swap module and ModuleRevenueV1 source

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26098754, stable() returned the tracked USDU token, coin() returned canonical USDC, vault() returned 0xbeef088055857739c12cd3765f20b7679def0f51 and checkValidModule was true. mintCap() returned 100000e18, totalAssets() returned 2470328000000000000 and totalMinted() returned 2468706000000000000. Source uses _mintWithCap for principal, uncapped _mint for fees and surplus, and atomic vault.withdraw for swapOut.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203 the USDU token's curator/guardian/module model was established (curator = 0x9fe66037c44236c87d9ac8345f489b4413fdff06, no guardian set, mintModule/burnModule gated to whitelisted modules). 2026-07-20 follow-up: full SetModule/SubmitModule event enumeration from block 0 found 9 historical module approvals, of which exactly five are currently valid (checkValidModule = true): 0xfb46481a9819e068af0eb64a2c2824fcecaaaa45, 0x8f36bbee57acb4857cb97898020b529969fdf221, 0x77cbb2f180f55dd2916bfc78f879a2c2de37f638, 0x5febefd5aecfefb3352c5edd49d634b1456c4bd7, 0x397fb4a34757ac180c0841b26131f25040e2e50b. The curator DAO proxy resolves to a standard Aragon OSx DAO implementation (0x58c1f7bc62bb63fb137bc8f6d8ea6321a0501d29): module approvals execute through the Aragon permission framework rather than a single EOA. Blockscout's verified direct Stablecoin source exposes the module-gated mint path and curator/guardian transitions, but no proxy or upgrader path; fixed-block EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were zero at Ethereum block 25573280.. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the curator can approve replacement mint adapters without an evidenced independent timelock, while the issuer backing API does not establish whole-supply reconciliation and no prudential supervisor or independent attestor is evidenced. Wave 2 external research reviewed 2026-08-15: USDU's public backing-snapshot API continuously exposes total backing, complete USDU supply, and Curve, TermMax, and Morpho adapter balances for its sole Ethereum deployment; this establishes issuer-operated whole-supply reconciliation, while no independent reserve attestor or prudential supervisor is documented.
